description:
TiCATi is a curated luxury travel platform with direct hotel contracts and exclusive guest benefits. Search thousands of hotels worldwide, get live room availability and pricing instantly in your currency, and explore curated cruise voyages with exclusive onboard credits and VIP amenities.
Ask for a hotel by name and TiCATi returns live rates immediately, no sign-in required. A personal concierge is available via WhatsApp for bookings, upgrades, and special requests.

defaultPrompt: Find the live rate for Aman Tokyo from 10 to 13 October for 2 adults
Which cruise would provide a very intimate experience with onboard credit included?
Find me a luxury hotel near the Champs-Élysées with availability for tomorrow
